items.docs: Submit an operator API call. The request body must be a JSON or Protobuf-encoded `Call` object. The `type` field determines the action, for example GET_HEALTH, GET_FLAGS, GET_VERSION, GET_METRICS, GET_LOGGING_LEVEL, SET_LOGGING_LEVEL, LIST_FILES, READ_FILE, GET_STATE, GET_AGENTS, GET_FRAMEWORKS, GET_EXECUTORS, GET_TASKS, GET_ROLES, GET_OPERATIONS, GET_WEIGHTS, UPDATE_WEIGHTS, GET_MASTER, RESERVE_RESOURCES, UNRESERVE_RESOURCES, CREATE_VOLUMES, DESTROY_VOLUMES, GROW_VOLUME, SHRINK_VOLUME, GET_MAIN
